**Finding: compliant** (rule LD — liquidated damages/penalties payable by Customer).

- **§5 Compensation (p0045, p0047):** only ordinary fees for requested Hosting/Support Services, invoiced monthly and payable within 15 days. No late-payment penalty, no fixed or stipulated damages. The blank minimum monthly amounts are in-term fees, not a termination payout.
- **§7 Unsolicited Commercial E-mail (p0049):** a behavioural covenant only — no per-message charge or penalty chargeable to Client.
- **§13/§14 Term and Termination (p0078, p0079):** Client may elect to terminate with services (and fees) simply running to the last day of the following month; there is no early-termination fee, minimum payout, or remaining-contract-value liability.

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties exist anywhere in the document, which sits at the playbook's **preferred** position, so no redline was proposed. Worth completing commercially (not a deviation): the blank minimum monthly fee figures in §5a, which §6 also carves out of Client's right to contest charges.
